body:
Milestone 9 (`project-pages`), research half: three more project home pages now show a figure from the project's own output.

- `experiments/figure.py` in each of `accel-kws` (accuracy vs modelled energy), `chip-pnr` (area and period ratios) and `ambient-pipeline` (stage memory). Each reads only the committed `results.txt`/`results.json` and runs nothing new; no numbers are added.
- One README line per project says how to redraw the figure.
- `PROJECTS.md` progress note: 10 projects ship an image.

Checked: figures viewed (accel-kws, chip-pnr), `python site/build.py` prints `ok: 393 projects, 3434 tests`, and each of the three project pages now contains an image. No test files changed.

Mirror-sync (oss-monorepo#7004) and mirror-guards (#6995) were already claimed, so I did not take them.
